exact_claim: For every integer d>=2 there is a nonempty open subset of the full real degree-d rational-map space Rat_d(R), of real dimension 2d+1, every one of whose periodic points in CP^1, at every positive period, belongs to RP^1.
real_topology: Ordinary real projective coefficient topology on the resultant-nonzero locus; no Zariski openness claimed.

independent_family.mechanism: Negative real residues, slope A>1, strict imaginary-part growth; real IFT and projective normalization at a persistent attracting fixed point give full ambient openness.
independent_family.initial_failed_run_reason: Squarefreeness check incorrectly required gcd equal to 1 instead of any nonzero constant; corrected by checking gcd degree zero.
